Kate, 2026-10-28: the two runs of `39_gc3_length_models.Rmd` on one figure. Reads the saved
fit and coefficient tables, so run `39_render_contrasts.R` first. Outcome in both is log2 TE
change, sictrl vs si3d; same genes, same z-scored predictors (GC3, log2 CDS length, log2 5'UTR
length), so the two conditions are directly comparable. Hypoxia in Okabe-Ito vermillion,
normoxia in Okabe-Ito bluish green.

```{r compare, fig.width = 13, fig.height = 6}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(tidyverse); library(here); library(patchwork) })
O <- here("output", "translational_control_overview")
runs <- c(hypoxia_1hr = "hypoxia 1hr", normoxia_1and4hr = "normoxia 1+4hr (time-regressed)")
cond_cols <- setNames(c("#D55E00", "#009E73"), runs)
rd <- function(kind) imap_dfr(runs, ~ read_csv(file.path(O, sprintf("gc3_length_models_%s_%s.csv", kind, .y)), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
                                mutate(condition = factor(.x, levels = runs)))
fit <- rd("fit"); co <- rd("coefficients")
mods <- unique(fit$model)
stopifnot("both runs must have the same models" = all(table(fit$model) == 2), length(mods) == 8)
fit <- fit %>% mutate(model = factor(model, levels = rev(mods)))
p_r2 <- ggplot(fit, aes(y = model, fill = condition)) +
  geom_col(aes(x = adj_r2), position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), width = 0.7) +
  geom_point(aes(x = cv_r2, group = condition), position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), size = 1.6, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cond_cols, name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "adjusted R² (bar); 10-fold CV R² (point)", y = NULL, title = "fit: log2 TE change, sictrl vs si3d") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
terms <- c("GC3", "CDS", "5'UTR")
cb <- co %>% filter(term %in% terms) %>%
  mutate(term = factor(term, levels = terms), model = factor(model, levels = rev(mods)))
p_beta <- ggplot(cb, aes(estimate, model, colour = condition)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = lo, xmax = hi), position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), size = 0.25) +
  facet_wrap(~ term, nrow = 1) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = cond_cols, name = NULL, guide = "none") +   # one legend, from the R2 panel
  labs(x = "coefficient: change in log2 TE change per SD (95% CI)", y = NULL, title = "linear coefficients") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) + theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom")
p <- (p_r2 + p_beta + plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1.6), guides = "collect") & theme(legend.position = "bottom")) +
  plot_annotation(title = "MDA-MB-231 si3d: TE change (sictrl vs si3d) explained by GC3, CDS length and 5'UTR length",
                  subtitle = "hypoxia 1hr vs normoxia 1+4hr (time-regressed); predictors z-scored; n = 10,054 genes in both")
p
if (isTRUE(params$save_plots)) ggsave(here("plots", "39b_gc3_length_models_hypoxia_vs_normoxia.pdf"), p, width = 13, height = 6)
knitr::kable(fit %>% dplyr::select(condition, model, adj_r2, cv_r2) %>% arrange(model, condition), digits = 4)
```
